exclude.reason: Pointer to a separately managed skill (~/.omp/agent/managed-skills/ui-ux-pro-max-skill); its 1.9 MB CSV dataset is vendored under data/, the pointer itself is not a loadable skill.
Upstream Pi entry point; Studio drives the OMP extension and stays the Pi target's first-class surface, so only one upstream factory is loaded.

notes: extension/index.ts is loaded through the Studio policy adapter (src/adapters/designer-engine.ts): a HOME shim resolves its hardcoded ~/.omp paths, Studio materialises the managed-skills and validator paths it expects, and a proxied ExtensionAPI lets Studio decide whether to honour upstream prompt injection, the 12-skill gate, and session-stop enforcement.

extensions/index.js is vendored for its exported helpers (resolveAuditCss, formatAuditResult) and its audit kernel; Studio never calls the upstream pi-ux extension factory, because Studio owns orchestration and mode state.
extensions/package.json is vendored because it carries the "type": "module" marker the upstream extension needs; without it Node re-parses the file on every load.
